height.description: Height of the collision box in blocks. A negative value will be assumed to be 0. Min value is -100000000.000000 Max value is 100000000.000000

width.description: Width of the collision box in blocks. A negative value will be assumed to be 0. Min value is -100000000.000000 Max value is 100000000.000000

description: Sets the width and height of the Entity's collision box.
